name: chart-kit

frames.best_why: Shows both charts fully drawn with their blue and hatched bars and teal area, with no tooltip covering them.

tagline: Bar and area charts with hatched columns and a glassy hover tooltip.
summary: Two dark chart cards: monthly visitor bars pairing a blue gradient series with orange hatching, and a teal price area. Hovering shows a frosted tooltip with values.
appearance: Two dark cards hold a twelve-month bar chart and a rising area chart. The bars alternate solid blue and diagonal orange hatching, while the area has a teal outline and fading teal fill over dotted gridlines.
behaviour: Bars grow in staggered from the baseline on load, and hovering a month dims the other columns and raises a frosted tooltip. The area chart draws a dashed cursor with a highlighted dot at the pointer.
demo_content: Visitor bars for Jan to Dec with Desktop and Mobile series, and a SOL/USD 24-day price area at $150.40.
use_when: A dashboard wants a richer chart presentation than default bars, with texture and hover detail.
avoid_when: The kit expects fixed arrays and colour tokens; swapping data or palette means editing the source.
customise: Data arrays, series labels and chart colours are exported constants; the demo charts compose them, so changes happen in source or by swapping constants.
weight_why: Two SVG charts with a one-shot grow and hover dimming; no continuous loop.

a11y.note: Charts skip the Recharts accessibility layer, so they expose no names or keyboard access; motion respects reduced-motion.

polish_why: Distinctive filled charts with thoughtful hatching and a frosted tooltip.
title: Chart Kit
